checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Woman in community garden, smiling, turning slightly toward camera
must.why: Smiling woman among raised beds and sunflowers; slight head movement, mostly faces camera.

must.item: Lower third reads exactly 'Maya Chen' above 'Community Gardener', no extra text
must.why: Second line reads 'The Chen'; caption also disappears at the end, and a faint watermark-like text appears at lower left.

must.item: Both lines legible white on dark backing, bottom left, no clipping
must.why: Maya Chen is white on dark band, but the second line is wrong; band edges are semi-transparent and faint at 0.7s.

must.item: Lower third doesn't cover face and stays stable
must.why: It doesn't cover the face but it vanishes by 6.7s and changes between frames.

must.item: Caption absent in first second, present from ~1s to end
must.why: Caption is already visible at 0.7s (faded in) and is gone at 6.7s.

faults.what: Second caption line reads 'The Chen' instead of 'Community Gardener'
Caption disappears before the end (absent at 6.7s) and appears before second 1
Faint stray watermark-like text at lower left in the last frame
Caption backing is semi-transparent and inconsistent in the first frame

summary: The garden video of a smiling woman looks good, but the caption fails: the second line reads 'The Chen', and the timing is wrong, with the caption showing at 0.7s and gone by 6.7s.
